basic.description: With true, leave out `content` and `draft_content` from each template, for lists that show names and metadata only. `has_draft` still says whether a draft exists.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

transactional.description: With true, list only templates sent over the transactional email API. With false, only the others. Leave out to list all templates.
